name: zombie_rider.live_native_band_continuity_mcw
description: A focused continuation of the accepted replacement proof: two tagged hostile riders begin on reciprocal east lanes, with only the east rider directly seeing the avatar.  A native southward path crosses behind a wall screen so the still-open bounded-relay and later-pressure boundary can be tested without replaying persistence.

steps.label: native_rider_band_fixture_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: two identified hostile riders load to the native World

steps.label: audit_saved_rider_band_time
steps.abort_reason: installed save did not prove expected noon footing

steps.label: audit_saved_rider_band_open_lanes
steps.abort_reason: fixture lacks the native reciprocal lanes or southward hiding path

steps.label: audit_saved_identified_rider_band_footing
steps.abort_reason: saved active_monsters did not prove the direct and relay riders

steps.label: operate_native_rider_band_continuity
steps.objective: Preserve the accepted replacement proof; do not replay it. Let the reciprocal riders take a native turn, confirm that only the east rider has direct sight, then move south on the declared floor path behind the screen. Observe a relay only if the southeast rider records relayed_direct_rider_sight sourced by the east rider with unchanged old position, observed turn and expiry. Continue only long enough to observe later native cooperative closing or pressure. Do not mutate membership, observations, destinations or attacks.
proof_targets: bounded shared old-location evidence after real sight loss
invariants: accepted replacement proof is predecessor evidence and is not replayed
no injected membership, observation, destination or attack
false convergence and blocked-route controls retain separate verdicts

steps.label: save_native_rider_band_for_replacement
steps.objective: Use the advertised native Save and Quit path, then Main-menu Quit and its native confirmation, so the encounter-derived band and bounded evidence cross a real replacement-process boundary.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the saved native world reaches Main menu and the original rider process exits before replacement

steps.label: audit_relaunched_native_rider_band_actors
steps.abort_reason: replacement process did not reload both tagged riders from the saved world

steps.label: observe_relaunched_native_rider_band
steps.objective: Observe the replacement native world only. The read-only band diagnostic must retain the same tagged actor IDs, one encounter-derived registry membership, revision and any unexpired bounded evidence. Finish for exact cleanup.
proof_targets: persisted band registry membership and bounded evidence

evidence_contract.claim: two native zombie riders form a durable encounter-derived band, share only bounded direct prey evidence, and apply later cooperative pressure without a shortcut
evidence_contract.writeback_note: fixture setup earns no behavior credit; native movement/turn receipts plus fixture-gated read-only diagnostic and replacement-process audit are required
